verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly has a dedicated first-party docs page for OpenFeature providers under its SDK documentation, which indicates official provider support. That support would let platform teams write flag code against the vendor-neutral OpenFeature API instead of LaunchDarkly's own SDK. The evidence is only a page title, though, so the depth and breadth of that support cannot be confirmed. Missing for 10: details on which languages or runtimes have providers, feature parity with the native SDKs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the providers in use.
